_comment: Master configuration for Mini SCADA — 5 x 33/11kV distribution substations, 41 devices

CRITICAL.description: High-High or Low-Low limit breach, Breaker TRIP — operator must manually ACK and clear

HIGH.description: High or Low limit breach, Comms failure — operator must manually ACK and clear

MEDIUM.description: Data quality degraded, freeze — auto-ACK and auto-clear when condition resolves

LOW.description: Informational, device restored — auto-ACK and auto-clear

register_map._comment: Same register map for every Modbus slave device. address = 0-based wire address (40001 -> 0), as shown in Wireshark

40003.description: Active power (stored as MW x100, e.g. 250 = 2.50MW)

40005.description: Temperature (stored as degC x10, transformer only)

substations.name: Rajajinagar 33/11kV Substation
substations._comment: This substation gets the full feeder map with load connectivity
